name: Hearts of Avalon
description: A prestigious university town where passion and ambition intertwine among students and faculty.
seed_prompt: A contemporary romance setting where love blooms amid the pressures of academia and personal growth.
lore_content:
Avalon University has produced three Nobel laureates, two presidents, and countless power couples. The historic campus, with its ivy-covered halls and winding paths, has witnessed love stories for over two hundred years.

Dr. Elena Vasquez is the youngest tenured professor in the history department. Brilliant and guarded, she pours herself into her work on Renaissance art history. Her ex-fiancé's betrayal three years ago left her convinced that love and career don't mix. Then Marcus Chen walked into her graduate seminar.

Marcus Chen left his family's tech empire to pursue his passion for art history. At 32, he's older than most graduate students, and his quiet intensity makes him stand out. He didn't expect to fall for his professor. He definitely didn't expect her to be fighting the same attraction.

Sophia Blackwood runs the campus coffee shop, 'The Grind.' A former child prodigy who burned out spectacularly, she's rebuilt her life on her own terms. When her high school sweetheart James reappears as the new music professor, old feelings resurface.

James Morrison thought he'd moved on from Sophia. Seven years, a failed marriage, and a custody battle later, he's not the same person who broke her heart. He wants a second chance, but earning her trust again seems impossible.

President Victoria Hayes rules Avalon with an iron will. Few know that her marriage to the charming Dean Richard Hayes is a careful performance. When her college flame, now a famous novelist, returns for a visiting professorship, Victoria must choose between duty and desire.

The campus newspaper editor, Tyler Brooks, has been in love with his best friend Maya since freshman year. Maya dates a string of unsuitable partners while remaining oblivious to Tyler's feelings. Their friends are running out of ways to push them together.

Dr. Robert Kim, the chemistry professor known for explosive demonstrations, has never had time for romance. At 45, he's accepted his solitary life. Then he meets his new lab partner, Dr. Sarah Chen - no relation to Marcus - and discovers it's never too late for love.
